html:
A Swedish furniture company founded in 1943 by Ingvar Kamprad, then seventeen, in the farm region of Småland. It is now the largest furniture retailer in the world.

The name comes from his initials and those of his family farm, Elmtaryd, and his home village, Agunnaryd. He began by selling pens, wallets and other small goods by mail, and added furniture in 1948. In the 1950s IKEA started selling furniture flat packed, for buyers to take home and put together themselves, which cut the cost of shipping and storage. The first store opened in Älmhult in 1958.

The big blue and yellow stores, with their set walking routes, room displays, self service warehouses and restaurants, spread across Europe and then the world. Its catalogue was printed in huge numbers each year. IKEA brought plain Scandinavian design to people who could not afford designer furniture.

Kamprad was later criticised for links to a Swedish fascist movement in his youth, which he called a great mistake. IKEA is controlled through foundations in the Netherlands.
sum: A Swedish furniture company founded in 1943 by Ingvar Kamprad, then seventeen, in the farm region of Småland. It is now the largest furniture retailer in the world.
